items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Knowing we are at 58 percent tells me nothing about who to ring on Monday.
Composite paraphrase: Give me a list I can print and I will get them in; a chart I cannot use.
items.implication: Record whether each practice has a named list owner.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The hospital took my bloods in May and the surgery called me in for the same thing in June.
items.implication: Keep duplicate testing as the balancing measure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The urine pot sits on my kitchen table because I cannot get to the surgery before it closes.
items.implication: Report completion by age band and deprivation.

summary: Four composite voices on actionable lists, recall work, duplicate testing and access.
